title: Adam Kadmon and the Anthropos
author: Ethan James Farrell
description: A comparative exploration of the primordial human in Jewish mysticism and Gnostic scripture. It follows Adam Kadmon and the Anthropos through creation, emanation and restoration, examining how the human form becomes a map of the cosmos and where the traditions diverge.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
